query: select now() as db_now,i.id,length(i.token) as original_token_length,(select count(*) from public.clinic_invitations x where x.token=i.token) as matching_original_token_rows,encode(extensions.digest(i.token,'sha256'),'hex') as token_digest,i.status,i.expires_at from public.clinic_invitations i where i.id='dd2f9c40-705c-42b8-b39a-4f04e4e9b7f7'
scope: Read-only supplementary token format/unique lookup verification after HTTP; same original digest binds unchanged capability to the prior request. No second redemption.
